name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: CVE-2026-88772 — Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
items.dek: Citrix NetScaler. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 30 September.

items.title: CVE-2026-88771 — Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
items.dek: Citrix NetScaler. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 30 September.

items.title: AgentXploit: Autonomous Repository-to-Runtime Red-Teaming for AI Agents
items.dek: AgentXploit reaches 59% success auditing AI agents for supply-chain injection, path traversal, and code execution flaws across 12 frameworks.
items.unproven: Effectiveness on proprietary agent architectures not in the benchmark; scalability to large codebases with complex tool chains.

items.title: Configuration, Not Conscience: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of LLM System Prompts
items.dek: Analysis of 407 leaked LLM system prompts finds 58% operational content, 5% safety policy, and significant cross-vendor reuse.
items.unproven: whether prompt composition patterns correlate with model safety outcomes; generalization beyond community-leaked sources

items.title: FragToken: Amplifying LLM Inference Costs through Noncanonical Token Generation
items.dek: FragToken amplifies LLM inference costs by training models to generate non-canonical token sequences without proportional output length increase.
items.unproven: stealthiness under production monitoring; deployability against modern rate-limiting and token-per-response budgets

items.title: Quantum interaction can superactivate cheating under parallel repetition
items.dek: Quantum communication superactivates cheating in parallel-repeated games despite soundness suppression in classical case.
items.unproven: quantum game theory with no application to secure-SDLC processes, SAST/DAST configuration, or software risk decisions

items.title: AuthGuard-R: Safety-Compliant Mission Hijacking and Dual-Gate Defense for LLM-Controlled Robots
items.dek: LLM-controlled robots can be hijacked to violate authenticated missions while passing safety checks; dual-gate authorization binds actions to signed mission scope.
items.unproven: Testing on robotics systems currently in SDLC; threat model assumes attacker can inject text, speech, visual, or document inputs but does not address all sensor tampering vectors.

items.title: Oracle Distillation
items.dek: Protocol distills noisy quantum oracle queries into high-fidelity single oracle under constant-rate depolarizing noise.
items.unproven: scalability to realistic problem sizes, practical demonstration on hardware, applicability beyond Boolean oracles

items.title: From Source Code to Network Profile: Automated and Traceable MUD Profile Generation for IoT Devices
items.dek: AutoMUD generates network access policies for IoT devices from firmware source code rather than traffic observation, reducing incomplete rules.
items.unproven: effectiveness on closed-source or obfuscated firmware; comparison of policy completeness against traffic-based baselines in production deployments

items.title: Sipser-Spielman meets Dijkgraaf-Witten: non-Abelian qLDPC codes via twisted sheaf gauge theory and almost-constant-overhead magic state fountain
items.dek: Twisted sheaf gauge theory unifies Sipser-Spielman codes with Dijkgraaf-Witten theory to construct non-Abelian qLDPC codes.
items.unproven: hardware implementation, overhead reduction in realistic fault rates, comparison to surface codes at practical scales

items.title: Complexity Barriers to State Preparation in Quantum Approximate Optimization
items.dek: Proves complexity barriers prevent uniform quantum algorithms from recovering fixed classical gain fraction on MaxCut.
items.unproven: whether non-uniform or heuristic quantum approaches bypass the barrier, practical problem instances where barrier applies

items.title: Fast and Secure Simultaneous Authentication of Equals for WPA3
items.dek: Proposed architectural fix offloads WPA3 SAE password-element computation to clients and adds ticket-based re-authentication to prevent AP DoS.
items.unproven: compatibility with existing WPA3 implementations; real-world deployment and adoption barriers

items.title: Parallel and Distributed Fermionic Simulation via Dynamic Encoding
items.authors: Michael Williams de la Bastida et al.
items.dek: Combinatorial covering designs reduce communication cost for distributed fermionic simulation from O(M⁴qr) to O(Mr).
items.unproven: wall-clock advantage accounting for design construction overhead, performance on current multi-QPU hardware, scaling beyond small molecules

items.title: Spatiotemporal Non-Hermitian Skin Effect with Floquet-Engineered Ultracold Atoms
items.dek: Proposes spatiotemporal non-Hermitian skin effect in Floquet-engineered ultracold atoms with tunable spatial accumulation.
items.unproven: experimental demonstration on atom-trap platforms, applicability to topological protection, advantage over static non-Hermitian systems

items.title: Context-Aware Functional Modeling for Android Third-Party Library Detection
items.dek: LibFan detects Android third-party libraries via context-aware contrastive learning and functional partitioning, handling obfuscation and partial reuse.
items.unproven: performance on real-world apps with mixed obfuscation; scalability to hundreds of libraries; comparison with existing detection tools

items.title: How Much Must a Private Mempool Hide? Exact Leakage Thresholds for Sandwich Attacks
items.dek: Exact analysis of sandwich attack profitability given partial transaction leakage in private mempools identifies the critical lower-bound threshold.
items.unproven: generalization beyond constant-product AMMs; applicability to multi-block or multi-token attack scenarios

items.title: Towards Understanding LLM-Based Log Anomaly Detection: An Empirical Study of Performance, Efficiency, and Robustness
items.dek: Empirical study of LLM log anomaly detection across adaptation strategies, model scales, and quantization settings on three public datasets.
items.unproven: Generalization beyond the three evaluated datasets; applicability to the reader's own log corpus and deployment patterns.

items.title: Causal Query Compression for Lindblad Dynamics: Optimal Queries and Nearly Linear Local Simulation
items.dek: Query compiler for Lindblad dynamics achieves worst-case optimal bounds independent of time-grid size.
items.unproven: quantum computing theory with no demonstrated implementation or relevance to classical software security tooling

items.title: Quantum environment afterglow from broadband excitation spectroscopy in superconducting qubits
items.dek: Broadband excitation spectroscopy reveals long-lived two-level systems in superconducting qubits affecting gate fidelity.
items.unproven: hardware characterization for quantum systems; does not inform decisions in classical software security or post-quantum migration planning

items.title: Electron lattice potentials for ultracold atoms using circular Rydberg orbitals
items.authors: Aileen A. T. Durst et al.
items.dek: Circular Rydberg orbitals form toroidal lattice potentials for ultracold atoms with intrinsically coupled phase.
items.unproven: quantum simulation proposal; outside reader's remit in software security and SDLC

items.title: Locality and filter design for dissipative ground-state preparation
items.dek: Linear programming and Lieb-Robinson bounds reduce ground-state preparation cost 116-fold on fixed time grids.
items.unproven: quantum algorithm optimization with no application to classical secure-SDLC tooling or software risk

items.title: Steady--State Current Signatures of Strong Light--Matter Coupling in Single--Molecule Junctions
items.dek: Steady-state current signatures resolve single-molecule strong light-matter coupling in STM break junctions.
items.unproven: quantum transport measurement technique; unrelated to application security or software development practices

items.title: The planted tensor problem over finite fields: algorithms and cryptography
items.dek: Planted totally-isotropic space problem over finite fields admits polynomial-time algorithm for d ≥ n/2 with implications for lattice hardness.
items.unproven: Practical cryptanalytic impact on standardized post-quantum schemes; parameters where hardness claim holds.

items.title: Peregrino: A Full-Hardware Accelerator for the Complete Falcon Post-Quantum Digital Signature Scheme on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
items.dek: Peregrino: first full-hardware Falcon post-quantum signature accelerator for edge devices, consuming 85K LUTs on Artix 7.
items.unproven: Integration with existing edge device deployment pipelines; comparison of performance and energy to software implementations.

items.title: Chiral Transfer and Entanglement Generation of Even-Parity Bell States with Engineered Two-Photon Loss
items.dek: Two-photon loss engineering generates even-parity Bell states with chiral transfer at exceptional points.
items.unproven: quantum state preparation protocol; outside scope of application security or software threat modeling
